story.titleZh: 创纪录！现代车队首次获得杆位
story.summaryZh: 明天FIA WEC 6小时巴塞罗那赛事中，现代车队Magma Racing将带领发车阵容，丰田车队#8赛车紧随其后，而#19赛车未能占据头排位置。
story.originalTitle: 🇪🇸 A FIRST-EVER POLE FOR GENESIS 🇪🇸 Tomorrow's Top 3 starting order sees Genesis Magma Racing lead the way for the inaugural FIA WEC 6 Hou...
story.summaryEn:
🇪🇸 A FIRST-EVER POLE FOR GENESIS 🇪🇸
Tomorrow's Top 3 starting order sees Genesis Magma Racing lead the way for the inaugural FIA WEC 6 Hours of Barcelona tomorrow! 🏁
Toyota Racing’s #8 machine, featuring manufacturer and driver title contenders, starts P2 after denying the #19 from making it a Genesis Magma Racing front-row lockout 🚀
Who will take the victory? 👀🏆
#FIA #WEC
detailZh:
🇪🇸 首次夺得杆位！🇪🇸
明天的前三名发车顺序中，Genesis Magma Racing将引领潮流，参加明天的FIA WEC巴塞罗那6小时耐力赛！🏁
Toyota Racing的#8赛车，拥有制造商和车手冠军争夺者，排在第二位发车，阻止了#19赛车成为Genesis Magma Racing的前排锁位 🚀
谁将夺得胜利？👀🏆
#FIA #WEC

relatedItems.originalTitle: Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁 Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed o...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁
Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed of 503.17 km/h, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h barrier.
The FIA is proud to recognise this achievement, highlighting BYD’s continued innovation and contribution to shaping the future of road car technology 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
detailZh:
庆祝汽车技术重大里程碑！🏁
祝贺比亚迪和杨王汽车U9 Xtreme车型以503.17 km/h的惊人速度突破500 km/h大关，成为首款超过500 km/h的生产汽车。
The FIA为这一成就感到自豪，并强调比亚迪在塑造道路汽车技术未来方面的持续创新和贡献 👏
#FIA #BYD #YANGWANG #SpeedRecognition
